title: Federal legal public holidays and the days they are observed
rule: Federal law lists eleven legal public holidays: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.'s Birthday, Washington's Birthday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. When one falls on a Saturday, most federal employees observe it on the Friday before; when it falls on a Sunday, on the Monday after.
changeWatch: A new federal holiday or a change to the observance rules.
